newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.6 bln for Oct 29.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.6 bln for Oct 29.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $1.598 billion in 61 offerings for Tuesday, October 29, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $484 million in 42 offerings.
Negotiated sales total $1.113 billion in 19 offerings. The largest issue is a $447 million North Carolina Eastern Municipal Power Agency issue through Smith Barney.
An additional three negotiated deals totaling $106 million are on Reuter's day-to-day calendar for Tuesday, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues depending on market conditions.
